crossRefs.note: When you build a new house, then you shall make a railing around your roof, so that you don’t bring blood on your house…
The houses of Jerusalem, and the houses of the kings of Judah, which are defiled, will be as the place of Topheth, even…
those who worship the army of the sky on the housetops, those who worship and swear by Yahweh and also swear by Malcam,
He built altars for all the army of the sky in the two courts of Yahweh’s house.
He walked in all the ways that his father walked in, and served the idols that his father served, and worshiped them;
and he abandoned Yahweh, the God of his fathers, and didn’t walk in the way of Yahweh.
He built altars for all the army of the sky in the two courts of Yahweh’s house.
He took away the foreign gods, and the idol out of Yahweh’s house, and all the altars that he had built in the mountain…
He brought out the Asherah from Yahweh’s house, outside of Jerusalem, to the brook Kidron, and burned it at the brook…

people.name: Ahaz
people.line: King of Judah, son of Jotham

people.name: Kidron
people.line: A valley east of Jerusalem, site of significant events

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: King of Judah, son of Hezekiah.

translations.web: The king broke down the altars that were on the roof of the upper room of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah had made, and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courts of Yahweh’s house, and beat them down from there, and cast their dust into the brook Kidron.
translations.bsb: He pulled down the altars that the kings of Judah had set up on the roof near the upper chamber of Ahaz, and the altars that Manasseh had set up in the two courtyards of the house of the LORD. The king pulverized them there and threw their dust into the Kidron Valley.
translations.kjv: And the altars that were on the top of the upper chamber of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah had made, and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courts of the house of the LORD, did the king beat down, and brake them down from thence, and cast the dust of them into the brook Kidron.
translations.asv: And the altars that were on the roof of the upper chamber of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah had made, and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courts of the house of Jehovah, did the king break down, and beat them down from thence, and cast the dust of them into the brook Kidron.
